acts.title: The Atomic Stroke
acts.description: A single point of kinetic amber light accelerates across the void, tracing the spine of a dynamic letterform. The stroke tensions, vibrates, and snaps into the word 'STROKE'.

acts.title: Elastic Tension & Structural Shear
acts.description: The letters undergo physical strain: serifs stretch into viscous filaments under angular shear forces, snapping back into crystalline precision as 'TENSION' converts into 'WEIGHT'.

acts.title: Topological Metamorphosis
acts.description: Hero transformation: The word 'FORM' melts into living continuous vector contours, swirling through volumetric space before re-converging into 'MOTION'.

acts.title: The Counter Portal
acts.description: The negative interior counter of the glyph 'O' expands into a luminous architectural portal, flooding the camera with spatial typographic dimension.

acts.title: Master Convergence & Payoff
acts.description: All typographic energy converges into the authoritative brand mark: KINETIC. Rules align, sub-bass impact strikes, and the signature breathes with living luminescence.
